title: Fix the Wrong File Mode
description: The program should write a line of text to a new file. Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
with open("notes.txt", "r") as f:
    f.write("Remember to buy milk")
expectedBehavior: The program should create notes.txt containing the text 'Remember to buy milk'.
actualProblem: The file is opened in "r" (read-only) mode, so calling f.write() raises an io.UnsupportedOperation error — you cannot write to a file opened for reading.
correctedCode:
with open("notes.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Remember to buy milk")
expectedOutput: The program creates notes.txt containing the text 'Remember to buy milk', with no errors printed.
explanation: The mode passed to open() determines what operations are allowed: "r" is read-only, while "w" opens the file for writing (creating it if it doesn't exist). Writing requires the correct mode.
